title: Delhi High Court seeks Central government response to plea challenging Gymkhana Club eviction move
description: The Delhi High Court on Monday sought the response of the Central government to two applications filed by a member of the Delhi Gymkhana Club and its staff welfare association against Central government’s move to evict the club from its 27.3-acre premises in Lutyens Delhi.Justice Avneesh Jhingan issued notice to the government and posted the matter for further hearing on July 28.The Estate Officer of the Land & Development Office (L&DO) had issued show cause notice to Gymkhana last
